name: Reading Time
description: Shows how long an article takes to read, and how much is left as you go.

gallery.author: OyNIx
gallery.summary: A quiet clock for long articles.
gallery.about: On pages with a real article, at least 400 words of running text, Reading Time adds a small pill to the bottom corner: “7 min read” at first, then “4 min left” as you scroll. It counts words in the article itself, not the menus and comments around it, and assumes 230 words a minute. Click the pill to hide it for that page.
